|birth = {{ne|977}}}}'''Lanita''' is a novice or Accepted that followed the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] in [[Salidar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lanita}}

==History==
Lanita was born in {{ne|977}} and went to the White Tower aged 17 in {{ne|994}}. She has been training six years, but we do not know if she took the Accepted test yet.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lanita}}

==Abilities==
Lanita is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a potential [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|32}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler. She would be unlikely to have reached he potential yet.

== Activities ==
She is one of the novices and Forsaken taken from the [[White Tower]] during the coup by [[Sheriam Bayanar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lanita}}

She is part of the [[Link]] controlled by [[Anaiya]], when the [[Bubble of evil]] erupts in [[Salidar]]. [[Anaiya Carel]] sends her to bed after it ends.{{ref/book|6|14}}
